body_markdown:
The seventh edition of the Global Fintech Fest returns to Mumbai from 8 to 11 September 2026, and this year the theme rests on three converging technologies: **agentic AI, tokenisation, and quantum.**


With participation expected from over 70 countries and more than 350 sessions on the agenda, GFF 2026 is where the industry stops asking what these technologies could do and starts showing what they already do.


That shift from potential to impact is a familiar one for us. Over the past decade, Cashfree Payments has built payments and banking infrastructure for more than 1 million businesses across India


As the industry works through what agentic AI, tokenisation, and next-generation security mean for real merchant workflows, our approach stays the same: adopt what makes payments safer and simpler for businesses, and ship it in a way that a merchant can actually put to use.


We will be at GFF 2026 in Mumbai, and we will have more to share from the floor.
